headless.description: Whether or not tests should be executed in headless mode.

testerHtmlPagePath.description:
Path relative to `ui/content` to find the `.html` to load.
The html file should expect to receive a `file` parameter that indicates which test to run.

state.description:
The current state for the tester.
See {@link TesterState} for all tester states.

results.description: The collected test results after the test execution.

engine.description: The action engine in which tests will execute.
